topic.title: Signing Up for an Account
topic.shortdesc: Information about signing up for a account.

body.p: If this is your first time using , you must create an account by signing up to . Go to the platform main page and look for the Sign Up option, that will display the sign up form. Follow the steps to complete the sign up process.

p.note: If is configured to provide Google or GitHub authentication, it only uses your social account to read your name and email address. No other data is accessed.

requires a valid email address to complete your account sign-up process. After the social login process, the authentication service might not provide your email address to . In this case, asks you to provide it.
